text:
olivia: quick RFC follow-up: batching + access-shim prototype landed in my branch. want a short runbook + perf expectations before we can canary

emi: drop the summary please

olivia: summary: lightweight access-shim that serves most allow/deny from an in-memory LRU; executor has continuous batching for small dashboard panels. shim miss triggers async policy fetch but we bound blocking to 60ms then apply deny-by-default unless client opts into stale reads

jordan: blocking concern: cold-miss path could amplify latency under churn (policy changes, token rotation)\
yun: agree. we should add a jittered backoff for refetch and keep a tiny hot-set of tenant policies pinned for 30s

olivia: plan steps I sketched:
1) shim v1 inline: LRU keyed by (tenant, scope), size 25k, TTL 5m
2) executor batching: wait up to 12ms headway or up to 48 requests per batch
3) miss handling: spawn background fetch, block up to 60ms, then fallback to deny or stale policy if x-console-allow-stale header present
4) telemetry: record shim_hit, shim_miss, fetch_latency_ms, fallback_used, batch_size, batch_latency_ms (sample 1%)

emi: can you paste config snippet

olivia: here:
```
console.batch = {
  max_latency_ms: 12,
  max_size: 48,
  tenant_bias_window_ms: 4,
}
console.access_shim = {
  cache_ttl_ms: 300000,
  cache_size: 25000,
  block_timeout_ms: 60,
  fallback: "tenant_read_only",
  allow_stale_header: "x-console-allow-stale"
}
```

jordan: tradeoffs: inline shim = lower network hop but increases executor CPU and allocation variability. sidecar a future move for heavy tenants\
yun: suggestion: start inline but gate with a CPU budget counter. if shim path consumes >10% CPU on executor, flip to sidecar experiment

olivia: rollout checklist:
- feature flag: console.access_shim.inline.v1 (default off)
- canary 3% for 24h, check shim_miss < 0.8% and p99 tail latency delta < 4%
- ramp 20% if good, then 100% after 72h of stability
- emergency fallback toggle to always deny (fail-closed) and a soft-fallback to allow-stale for non-critical routes

emi: perf numbers from benchmark?

olivia: synthetic dashboard run: small-panel throughput x2.4, p95 latency down ~15%. cold-miss adds 40-90ms depending on policy store RTT
jordan: note cost: batching ups resource efficiency but raises queueing; add queue depth hard limit and adaptive shedding when queue > 80%\
yun: I'll own telemetry + alerts. propose alerts: shim_miss_rate > 1%, fallback_used > 0.5%, p99 latency increase > 5%

olivia: owners: impl: olivia + jordan. telemetry + rollout: yun + emi. infra toggles: infra team

infra-bot: deploybot: feature flag console.access_shim.inline.v1 created by olivia

emi: update evals to include mixed-tenant workload (one heavy tenant + many tiny tenants) to validate batching fairness
jordan: also add token-rotation scenario to ensure cold-miss storm handling

olivia: will update RFC doc and open PR with tests. planning to kick off a 24h canary next Tuesday

emi: :thumbsup: ping when canary starts\
olivia: will do, thanks everyone
